result.description: A fictional 27-inch OLED reference monitor for color grading, motion graphics, and studio preview work. It features a 2560 x 1440 panel, 240 Hz refresh rate, 0.03 ms response time, factory-calibrated wide-gamut color coverage, and HDMI 2.1 plus DisplayPort 1.4 inputs. Designed for creative workstations rather than gaming or storage applications.
